jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Lear For You

Lear, a global automotive technology leader in Seating and E-Systems, enables superior in-vehicle experiences for consumers around the world. Our diverse team of talented employees in 38 countries is driven by a commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and sustainability. Lear is Making every drive better™ by providing the technology for safer, smarter, and more comfortable journeys. Lear, headquartered in Southfield, Michigan, serves every major automaker in the world and ranks #186 on the Fortune 500. Further information about Lear is available at lear.com, or follow us on Twitter @LearCorporation.

Job description, responsibilities and duties

• Assist the Plant Controller in all aspects of corporate and internal reporting to ensure adherence to timetables, financial integrity and completeness.
• As with all roles within the Finance department, the role will involve financial control testing to ensure SOX compliance.
• Assist in budget and short-term forecast preparation, profit and loss, cashflow and balance sheet.
• Management of key KPIs including Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable aging.
• SOX Testing Reviews and presentation to the Financial Manager.
• Balance Sheet Reconciliation Reviews.
• Calculation and accounting for reserves
• Management and completion of month-end processes including variance analysis.
• Working closely with external auditors for year end and interim audit work.
• Assist with special finance projects and automations

Personality requirements and skills

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Financial controlling.
• Previous experience in a manufacturing environment; automotive industry experience is highly preferred.
• Proven experience with: Financial reporting and analysis, Budgeting and forecasting, Month-end and year-end closing activities, Balance sheet reconciliations, Cost accounting and inventory accounting, Cash flow management
• Experience with external and internal audits.
• Hands-on experience with SOX compliance or internal controls.

Employee perks, benefits

• Year-end bonus – 13th salary
• Meal allowance
• Anniversary benefit.
• Referral benefit
• Company canteen
• Flexible working hours
• Vitamin package, fruit days every month, Christmas gifts
• Employee coffee
• Financial consultations.

jobs.title: Foundry Development Program Manager
jobs.description:
Lear For You

We work hard for the people who work for us. We champion our teams and foster collaboration, inclusion, respect and excellence. Because we want to be more for you.

A path to a better career. A better future.

Our teams have invented groundbreaking technologies, manufactured millions of products and earned a long list of awards. Year after year, we’re named one of the World’s Most Admired Companies.

They’re the secret to our success—empowered, inventive and inclusive. Passionate about their craft. Driven to succeed. Because we win together.

Are you ready for a better career? A better future?

Job Description

Lear is seeking a highly experienced Foundry Development Program Manager to lead the delivery of enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives powered by Foundry. This role sits at the intersection of business transformation, data, technology, and program execution, partnering closely with Business Process Owners, Forward Deployed Engineers, Data Architects, and global delivery teams to drive measurable business outcomes. This is a high-impact leadership position responsible for coordinating complex programs spanning multiple business functions, technical teams, external partners, and global stakeholders. The successful candidate will ensure solutions are delivered on time, at quality, and ready for enterprise deployment.

Responsibilities

Lead Enterprise Transformation Programs
• Drive end-to-end execution of large-scale Foundry programs from initiation through deployment and stabilization.
• Establish governance structures, executive reviews, operating cadences, and steering committees.
• Develop and maintain integrated program plans across business, technical, data, and partner workstreams.
• Provide executive visibility into program status, risks, dependencies, milestones, and resource needs.
• Ensure stakeholder alignment, accountability, and successful delivery execution.
Orchestrate Complex Delivery Ecosystems
• Act as the central delivery leader across Lear Digital Operations, IT, Data & Analytics, Palantir, system integrators, and third-party partners.
• Coordinate delivery activities across application development, data products, integrations, infrastructure, testing, deployment, and support transitions.
• Manage cross-functional dependencies and execution risks.
• Drive alignment on commitments, resource plans, release schedules, and deployment readiness.
Partner with Business and Technical Leaders
• Work closely with Business Process Owners to translate priorities into executable delivery roadmaps.
• Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers on release planning, technical dependencies, and delivery strategy.
• Collaborate with Data Architects on data readiness, integration planning, governance, and implementation sequencing.
• Support user acceptance testing, deployment planning, and operational readiness activities.
• Remove organizational barriers impacting delivery success.
Govern Delivery and Program Performance
• Manage scope, schedule, quality, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
• Lead release planning, testing, cutover, hypercare, and production transition activities.
• Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and supportability standards.
• Establish governance controls and performance metrics to monitor program health.
• Drive issue resolution and escalation management across all workstreams.
Manage Strategic Partners and Vendors
• Oversee performance across Palantir resources, consulting partners, system integrators, and development providers.
• Establish accountability for deliverables, timelines, quality standards, and deployment readiness.
• Monitor delivery performance and contractual commitments.
• Resolve partner-related issues and continuously improve delivery processes and governance models.

Your Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Business, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
• 10+ years leading large-scale digital transformation, enterprise technology, software delivery, or business transformation programs.
• Proven success managing complex, multi-year initiatives involving internal and external delivery organizations.
• Experience working across business teams, IT organizations, software vendors, consulting partners, and data teams.
• Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, release management, program governance, and deployment methodologies.
• Experience with enterprise data platforms, analytics environments, integrations, or digital manufacturing solutions.

Bonus If You Have

- Master's degree preferred.

- Manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, or operations experience preferred.

Job Description

NEW CAREER OPPORTUNITY | OPERATIONS MANAGER

SAN LUIS POTOSI, S.L.P.

Are you a results-driven operations leader with a strong background in automotive manufacturing and customer-focused execution? Join our team and play a key role in supporting our BMW operations. In this position, you will lead manufacturing operations, drive strategic initiatives, strengthen operational excellence, and deliver business objectives through disciplined execution, people development, and close alignment with customer expectations.

Responsibilities

- Monitor and improve key operational KPIs, including OEE, scrap, productivity, efficiency, PPM, delivery performance, absenteeism, and turnover.

- Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement activities, including Kaizen, 5S, value stream mapping, waste reduction, and structured problem solving.

- Manage new project launches, SOP readiness, ramp-up activities, line transfers, and operational readiness for customer programs.

- Promote and maintain best manufacturing practices across the plant.

- Ensure compliance with all safety, health, environmental, and regulatory standards.

- Strengthen the plant safety culture, reduce incidents, and ensure compliance with EHS standards and internal safety systems.

- Develop, coach, and mentor team members, building a high-performance culture and a strong talent pipeline.

- Foster strong customer relationships while ensuring exceptional service and operational performance.

- Manage – prevent customer escalations, audits, containment actions, 8D problem solving, war rooms, and recovery plans to restore operational performance.

- Lead organizational readiness and execution of strategies to achieve short- and long-term goals.

- Oversee operational cost control, budget adherence, productivity actions, headcount optimization, and CAPEX/OPEX discipline.

Skills

Root Cause Analysis
Multilingualism
Material Requirements Planning
Analytical Skills
Record Keeping
Kaizen Methodology
Cooperation

Education Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field.

- Strong understanding of automotive quality standards, including IATF 16949, customer-specific requirements, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC, Control Plan, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Experience Requirements

- Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Operations Manager or in a senior manufacturing leadership role within an automotive manufacturing environment.

- Experience working directly with German automotive customers.

- Experience managing / preventing customer escalations, automotive audits, 8D methodology, containment activities, and performance recovery plans.

- Experience in JIT/JIS manufacturing environments is highly desirable, particularly in operations supporting premium automotive customers.

- Strong knowledge of internal logistics, material flow, inventory control, sequencing, production planning, and delivery performance in JIT/JIS operations.

- Experience managing operational budgets, cost reduction initiatives, productivity improvements, headcount planning, and basic financial indicators.

- Hands-on experience with Lean Manufacturing tools, Kaizen, 5S, value stream mapping, waste reduction, and structured problem-solving methodologies.

- Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across production, quality, maintenance, engineering, logistics, and continuous improvement.

- Proven leadership skills with the ability to inspire, engage, and develop teams.

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.

- Experience with ERP, SAP, MES, or similar production management systems.

- Advanced English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, regional teams, and senior BMW stakeholders.

- Availability to support critical operational needs, customer audits, shift changes, and urgent production situations when required.

Certifications / Licenses

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lear Corporation is committed to fair, merit‑based employment practices and equal opportunity.
